text:
Maya Chen: Quick heads-up — offsite is confirmed for Tue-Wed, May 12-13. Primary asks: lock facilitation owners, finalize the prioritization flow, and clarify launch criteria per initiative. Can product leads confirm session owners + prework by EOD Friday?

Jon Ortiz: I can facilitate the customer-asks block. Thinking 90m: 10m lightning intros, 55m breakouts to score, 25m synthesis + decision.

Leo Park: For prioritization, propose 2-step: 1) quick RICE triage in small groups, 2) final allocation using "investment buckets" (must-do / accelerate / incubate / deprioritize). Keeps tradeoffs explicit.

Sara V.: Hybrid note — who owns room A AV? remote folks reported dropouts last time. Need dedicated mics + one laptop for each breakout table. @Mike R. ?

Mike R.: I’ll handle AV. Booking mics and an RT engineer for Wed morning. Will coordinate with People Ops for room layout.

Amy Patel: Prework ask: every PM to add top 3 customer-driven asks to the PRD page, include short impact estimate + known deps. Tag with `offsite-prework`. Link: https://notion.redwood/product/offsite-prework

Alex Gomez: Curious about decision mechanics — dot voting is fast but biases loud voices. RICE gives numbers but slow. Combination sound good?

Maya Chen: Agree with Leo/Alex mix: RICE for initial filtering (15m per card), then investment-bucket discussion with audible tradeoffs and final dot allocation (200 points per group). We'll publish scoring rubric.

Jon Ortiz: Also need explicit launch criteria per initiative during the synthesis step. Suggest we ask owners to bring a one-paragraph "launch checklist" covering: security, observability, SLOs, rollout plan, launch metric.

Leo Park: I'll drop a simple launch criteria template in Notion. Minimal fields so people can fill in quickly.

Amy Patel: Example template (I'll paste here for visibility):
```
Must-have
- Security: KMS & audit enabled
- Reliability: <1% error rate, P50 < 250ms on sample workload
- Observability: traces and dashboard with alert thresholds
Success metrics
- 7-day active integrations >= 3
- Conversion lift >= 5% for targeted cohort
QA signoff
- QA owner: name
- Rollback criteria: sustained >=5% user-impact errors for 30m
```

Sara V.: Good. Add a privacy review checkbox for any feature touching customer data.

Mike R.: Ops note: if an initiative needs Dedicated capacity, flag it in prework — procurement lead needs 3 weeks notice.

Alex Gomez: For facilitation roles: can we split synth+decision from the facilitator so PMs don't feel pressured? e.g., facilitator runs timebox, an executive sponsor calls final tradeoffs.

Maya Chen: Yes — plan: facilitator + sponsor for each block. Facilitator runs the method, sponsor adjudicates final bucketing. Please volunteer when you confirm ownership.

product-bot: Reminder: offsite prework form closes Fri 17:00 PDT. 6 submissions so far.

Jon Ortiz: Logistics: bring printed 1-pagers for each initiative (two copies per table). Also prep a 3-slide lightning deck for each owner (problem, proposed solution, risks & deps).

Amy Patel: Quick ask on scope negotiation etiquette — we should agree on a default MERGE policy: if conflicting owners both claim priority, escalate to the sponsoring PM + Eng IC for a tie-break, documented in the notes.

Leo Park: Agreed. Also recommend we capture "non-starters" explicitly (what we won't do this year) to prevent scope creep.

Maya Chen: Final checklist I need from everyone by EOD Fri: 1) session owner confirmed, 2) prework submitted, 3) launch checklist draft on Notion, 4) any hard constraints (procurement, legal). I'll collect and publish the agenda by Monday.

Sara V.: I'll coordinate the hybrid run-through on Monday 4pm PT (30m). Everyone with remote attendees please join.

Mike R.: AV run-through invite sent. CC'ing People Ops.

Alex Gomez: I'll be sponsoring the "customer asks" block. Jon — happy to serve as co-sponsor for decisions.

Maya Chen: Perfect — thanks all. If anyone can't meet the EOD Fri prework ask, ping me directly and we’ll triage. :thumbsup:
